name: work-order-lifecycle
description: Creates a work order and walks through workflow transitions: Requested → Approved → In Progress → Completed → Closed

doc_metadata.title: Work Order List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the Work Order list page. This page displays all work orders with their current workflow status, priority, and assigned personnel.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Opening screenshot for the Work Order chapter.

doc_metadata.title: Create New Work Order
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a new work order. The form opens with default values including the 'Requested' workflow state.

steps.value: E2E Test Work Order — Pump maintenance

doc_metadata.title: Fill Form Field
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Test Work Order — Pump maintenance" into the Description field.

doc_metadata.title: Save Work Order
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Save' to create the work order. The system assigns a unique code and sets the initial workflow state.

doc_metadata.title: Work Order Initial State
doc_metadata.caption: After saving, the work order is in the initial workflow state. The workflow dropdown in the header shows available transitions.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Highlight the workflow state badge and dropdown.
